dashboard.subtitle: Monitor authentication health, active sessions, and security events

users.subtitle: Create, edit, and manage user accounts

super_admin.label: Super Admin
super_admin.description: Full platform access, can manage all modules and users

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Module management, user management, settings access

user.label: User
user.description: Standard module access, read and write

sessions.subtitle: View and manage active user sessions across the platform

auditLog.subtitle: Track all authentication events — logins, logouts, failures, and changes

config.pageSubtitle: Configure authentication providers, password policies, and session settings

provider.title: Authentication Provider
provider.description: Select the authentication method for the platform. JSON File is the default and works without a database.

json_file.label: JSON File
json_file.description: Authenticate against a local users.json file. Default mode — works without a database.
json_file.detail: Ideal for initial setup, development, and bootstrap before database is configured.

database.label: Database
database.description: Authenticate against the PostgreSQL system_users table with bcrypt password hashing.
database.detail: Requires the database to be initialized with default data. Switch here after setup.

social.label: Social / OAuth2
social.description: Authenticate via Google, Microsoft, or other OAuth2 providers.
social.detail: Requires OAuth2 provider configuration. Available in a future release.

provider.dbNotReadyWarning: Database must be initialized before switching to Database authentication.
provider.dbRequiredNote: Set up the database in Admin → Settings → Database Objects first.

password.title: Password Policy
password.description: Enforce password strength requirements across all user accounts

session.title: Session Policy
session.description: Control session duration and concurrent login limits

lockout.title: Account Lockout Policy
lockout.description: Protect against brute-force attacks by locking accounts after failed attempts

tokens.title: Token Settings
tokens.description: Configure JWT token expiry and refresh token rotation
